summary: Preserved the marker-only warmup reuse implementation from amdpilot-org/sglang PR 2824 and corrected the independently reproduced false compatibility match from PR 2928. DeepGEMM identity now hashes a deterministic manifest of the full import package and distribution-owned implementation artifacts, including sibling JIT sources and native libraries outside deep_gemm.__file__. If no implementation artifacts can be identified, marker reuse and publication are disabled so startup falls back to the all-M warmup.
